Now let me look at the `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash` function more carefully. The issue is that it calls `cbor_bytestring_handle` and `cbor_bytestring_length` on `hash_item_value` without checking if it's actually a bytestring. Let me also look at the `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_entity` function:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>sed -n '216,245p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c && echo "===" && sed -n '300,380p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd/libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
